findings.explanation: The text and title imply impedance-based prediction and a values aggregation; the SPL uses neither impedance nor any trend, and `battery_age_months` is not a standard APC object (description vs spl).
findings.quote: Summarises `values` grouped by `host` across `the scheduled window` before applying `age_months` > 36.
findings.suggested_fix: Describe the real logic: replace indicator set, or battery age over 36 months from a defined source such as last-replace date; say how battery_age_months is derived.

findings.explanation: Does not say how age is obtained or which OID values mean replace, and procurement integration is unexplained.
findings.quote: (1) Validate vendor-specific replace OID mapping. (2) Integrate with procurement SKU.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the replace-indicator and last-replace-date objects and their value meanings, and state the 36-month rule.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: Title promises prediction from age and impedance; the SPL uses neither impedance nor any forecasting.

`upsSmartBatteryReplace` is an unverified object name; `match(lower(_raw), "(?i)replace battery")` is unlikely to match polled SNMP events; grouping by `host` rather than `ups_name` may identify the collector instead of the UPS.

summary: The title promises prediction from age and impedance, but the SPL only checks a pre-existing age field, a replace flag and raw text; no impedance or prediction exists and the age source is undefined.
